definitions.explanation: The final result of reasoning or discussion.

examples.japanese: {結論|けつろん}から{言|い}うと、{失敗|しっぱい}だった。
examples.english: To put it simply, it was a failure.

notes:
{結論|けつろん} is the final conclusion.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {結論|けつろん}を{出|だ}す (to reach a conclusion)
- {結論|けつろん}に{達|たっ}する (to arrive at a conclusion)
- {結論|けつろん}から{言|い}うと (to put it simply)
- {結論|けつろん}を{急|いそ}ぐ (to rush to conclusions)
